description: Get RedTrack aggregated report grouped by a dimension (e.g. campaign, offer, source, country, sub1-sub20, date, hour). Includes metrics like impressions, clicks, conversions, cost, revenue, profit, ROI, CR, EPC, CPC.

date_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 7 days ago.

group.description: Grouping dimension(s), comma-separated for nested groups (e.g. campaign,sub1): campaign, offer, source, landing, network, country, region, city, os, browser, device, device_brand, connection_type, isp, date, hour, day_of_week, sub1-sub20, rt_source, rt_medium, rt_campaign, rt_adgroup, rt_ad, rt_placement, rt_keyword

sortby.description: Metric(s) to sort by, up to 3 comma-separated (e.g. revenue, profit, clicks, roas)

tracks_view.description: Use cached costs for faster report generation

name: get_report
